Ukraine Reports First Combat Use of Own Ballistic Missile

Ukraine has reported the first combat use of its domestically produced FP 7 ballistic missile. President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that the missile was used against Russia, though he did not reveal specific targets. The missile's debut in combat was noted by multiple news outlets.
